oneShotStopAndWriter.prefix: Exclusive wx, one-shot best-effort retained prefix. NOT atomic, fsync, crash-durable, guaranteed all-fragment output or transaction. Filesystem failure may leave a partially created file absent from manifest and may also prevent manifest/receipt. Preserve directory, no deletion/rewrite, report uncertainty/outer error and no producer retry. Writer marks itself used before first fragment, including failed write.
oneShotStopAndWriter.runnerThrow: If no runResult exists, do not invent trace or call writer; retain bounded runner-error receipt if possible. Writer failure, binding failure and terminal receipt collision remain separate errors.
